title: 我的身体我做主
subtitle: 这是我的身体
character: wearing a yellow sweater, light blue trousers and white socks, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft oil pastel on warm kraft paper, rounded gentle shapes, warm peach, sky blue and lavender palette, cozy and reassuring
facts: 泳衣盖住的地方，别人不能看、不能碰
不舒服的触碰，可以大声拒绝
马上走开，告诉爸爸妈妈或老师
让我不舒服的秘密，要告诉爸爸妈妈

pages.zh:
这是我的身体。
我的小手会画画，我的小脚会跑步，
我的嘴巴会唱歌，我的眼睛会看好多好多东西。
从头顶到脚趾头，
我的身体，是我自己的。
pages.scene: The little boy stands proudly with his arms stretched wide in a sunny meadow, smiling, holding a crayon in one hand.

pages.zh:
我喜欢妈妈抱抱我，
也喜欢爸爸把我举得高高的，转一个圈。
这样的抱抱，让我觉得开心、安全，
心里暖暖的。
让人舒服的触碰，是好的触碰。
pages.scene: In a cozy living room the father, a grown adult man in a light blue shirt, lifts the little boy high up in the air, both laughing, warm lamp light.

pages.zh:
可是有时候，我不想要。
奶奶想亲亲我的脸，可我今天不想被亲，
我可以有礼貌地说：
「奶奶，我们击个掌吧！」
奶奶笑着说：「好呀！」我的身体，我可以说了算。
pages.scene: The little boy gives a cheerful high five to his smiling grandmother, a kind elderly woman with grey hair and glasses, in a cozy home.

pages.zh:
夏天去海边的时候，我们会穿上泳衣。
你看，一条小泳裤，一件小泳衣，
穿上以后，被泳衣盖住的地方，
叫做「隐私部位」。
那是每个人身上最需要保护的地方。
pages.scene: Top-down view of a striped beach towel spread on the sand. On the towel lie a pair of small blue swim trunks and a small one-piece swimsuit, both neatly folded flat, next to a little sun hat, a red pail and spade, and a colorful beach ball, the whole towel filling the picture.

pages.zh:
隐私部位是自己的，要好好保护。
别人不可以看，也不可以碰；
我们也不去看、不去碰别人的。
上厕所、换衣服的时候，
我们会把门关上。
pages.scene: A plain closed bathroom door seen straight on from the hallway, firmly shut, with a small round wooden sign hanging on the door handle. The door fills most of the picture and nothing behind it can be seen.

pages.zh:
只有在生病、需要检查身体的时候，
医生可以帮我们检查，
而且爸爸妈妈会一直陪在旁边，
医生也会先告诉我们要做什么。
这样的检查，是为了让我们快点好起来。
pages.scene: At a friendly doctor's office the little boy sits fully dressed on the examination bed with two different grown-ups beside him: on one side a friendly male doctor with short grey hair and glasses in a white coat listens to his chest with a stethoscope over his sweater, and on the other side his mother, a grown adult woman with long black hair tied back in a lavender cardigan, sits close and holds his hand.

pages.zh:
如果有人想碰我的隐私部位，
或者让我觉得不舒服、害怕，
不管他是谁，我都可以大声地说：
「不可以！」
说不，不是没礼貌，是在保护自己。
pages.scene: The little boy stands firmly on his own with his feet apart and stretches one arm straight out in front of him toward the viewer, his palm flat and facing forward like a traffic police officer's stop sign, a brave serious face, a plain warm background.

pages.zh:
说完，我就马上走开，
去找爸爸妈妈，或者老师，
去找我信任的大人。
我跑得快快的，
一刻也不在那里多待。
pages.scene: The little boy runs along a hallway toward his mother, a grown adult woman with long black hair tied back, in a lavender cardigan, who kneels down and opens her arms to catch him.

pages.zh:
不管是谁，
就算他说「这是我们两个人的小秘密」，
就算他说不许告诉别人，
我也要告诉爸爸妈妈。
让我不舒服的秘密，不用保守。
pages.scene: The little boy whispers into the ear of his mother, a grown adult woman with long black hair tied back in a lavender cardigan, as they sit together on a sofa, the mother listening carefully, warm lamp light.

pages.zh:
妈妈抱着我，轻轻地说：
「你告诉我，你做得很对。
不管发生什么，爸爸妈妈都会相信你、保护你。」
我的身体，我做主！
我知道怎么保护自己啦。
pages.scene: The mother, a grown adult woman with long black hair tied back in a lavender cardigan, hugs the little boy on the sofa, both smiling, a warm cozy room with soft light.
